protocol.cohort: Repeatedly evaluated ICU100; exploratory, not untouched independent test
protocol.comparisons: strict |score| > threshold and component area > cutoff
protocol.coordinate_space: original current-image array; unchanged affine; inverse training orientation
protocol.selection: Synthetic validation best checkpoint; never selected on ICU performance
protocol.matcher: Actual legacy OV and independently checked reference-first greedy one-to-one counts
protocol.detection_f1: Per-reader pooled component F1; not pixel Dice or legacy boosted per-pair agreement
protocol.reader_SD: Variability across five clinician scores, not across seeds or a confidence interval
protocol.publication: Aggregates and numeric plots only; scans, case IDs, predictions and weights stay on campus
